lines.hook: A cold day can cut your E.V.'s range by up to forty-one percent.
lines.bars: In triple-A's lab test, range dropped twelve percent with the heater off, and forty-one percent with it on.
lines.why: Most of that loss is heating, not the battery itself.
lines.fix: So pre-heat the car while it's still plugged in. It warms up on grid power, not on your range.
lines.outro: Send this to an E.V. driver before winter.
